title: better wynncraft mounts
body:
Better Wynncraft Mounts
Better Wynncraft Mounts is a client-side mod designed to significantly enhance your mounting experience on the Wynncraft MMORPG server.

🌟 Key Features
1. Dynamic Camera Bobbing
Smoothly synchronizes your camera movement (bobbing) with your mount's speed and type. Fully compatible with both 1st-person and 3rd-person perspectives, this feature eliminates the unnatural, rigid camera behavior of vanilla Wynncraft and provides a much more immersive riding experience. looks better with [camera overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/cameraoverhaul).

2. Enhanced Jump Bar & Perfect Jumps
Provides a visual custom jump bar for wynncraft mounts. When you perform the highest jump, there’s a simple effect.

3. Sneak Camera Drop Cancellation
to lower the wyvern's altitude use the Shift (Sneak) key. Due to vanilla mechanics, sneaking causes your camera to instantly drop, creating an annoying screen jitter. This mod completely cancels out the sneak camera drop while riding a mount, maintaining perfectly smooth and stable camera work while you are riding wyverns andany other mounts.

4. Fully Configurable
Every aspect of the mod can be customized to your liking via the dedicated configuration file (better_wynncraft_mounts.json) or modmenu.

Customize the jump bar color with full ARGB (transparency) support, individually for both the HUD and world-space bars.
Adjust the thickness of the HUD bar and the size of the world-space jump bar.
Fine-tune the bobbing amplitude and frequency for different types of mounts.
⚙️ Dependencies
Fabric Loader (for 1.16.3)
Fabric API
📝 Notes
This mod is entirely client-side. You do not need to install it on a server. While specifically tailored for the Wynncraft server, some features may partially function in other server environments.
